de: Playwright Thomas Kyd's accusations of heresy lead to an arrest warrant for Christopher Marlowe.

te: Alonso de Ojeda sets sail from Cádiz on his voyage to what is now Venezuela.

de: Alonso de Ojeda sets sail from Cádiz on his voyage to what is now Venezuela.

de: During the Battle of Buyur Lake, General Lan Yu leads a Ming army forward to crush the Mongol hordes of Tögüs Temür, the Khan of Northern Yuan.

te: Fall of Acre, the end of Crusader presence in the Holy Land.
dz: 阿克里的倒下,十字军在圣地存在的终结.
de: Fall of Acre, the end of Crusader presence in the Holy Land.

t: 安提俄克公国是一个十字军国家,在安提俄克的围城中倒向了马姆卢克苏丹白巴人.
te: The Principality of Antioch, a crusader state, falls to the Mamluk Sultan Baibars in the Siege of Antioch.
dz: 安提俄克公国是一个十字军国家,在安提俄克的围城中倒向了马姆卢克苏丹白巴人.

te: The future Henry II of England marries Eleanor of Aquitaine. He would become king two years later, after the death of h…
dz: 未来的英格兰亨利二世与阿基塔内的埃莉诺结婚. 他将在两年后成为国王,在他表弟去世后,一度罢免了英格兰国王斯蒂芬.
de: The future Henry II of England marries Eleanor of Aquitaine. He would become king two years later, after the death of his cousin once removed King Stephen of England.

t: 大约 800 名犹太人在德国沃尔姆斯被屠杀。
te: Around 800 Jews are massacred in Worms, Germany.
dz: 第一次十字军东征：大约 800 名犹太人在德国沃尔姆斯被屠杀。
de: First Crusade: Around 800 Jews are massacred in Worms, Germany.

t: 教宗本笃八世在其前任教宗塞尔吉乌斯四世于当月早些时候去世后开始他的教宗.
te: Pope Benedict VIII begins his papacy following the death of his predecessor Pope Sergius IV earlier that month.
dz: 教宗本笃八世在其前任教宗塞尔吉乌斯四世于当月早些时候去世后开始他的教宗.
de: Pope Benedict VIII begins his papacy following the death of his predecessor Pope Sergius IV earlier that month.

t: 意大利的路易二世在罗马第二次被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝,享年47岁. 他第一次加冕是在前28年,84…
te: Louis II of Italy is crowned for the second time as Holy Roman Emperor at Rome, at the age of 47. His first coronation …
dz: 意大利的路易二世在罗马第二次被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝,享年47岁. 他第一次加冕是在前28年,844年他父亲洛泰一世统治期间.
de: Louis II of Italy is crowned for the second time as Holy Roman Emperor at Rome, at the age of 47. His first coronation was 28 years earlier, in 844, during the reign of his father Lothair I.

te: Emperor Constantine the Great announces free distributions of food to the citizens in Constantinople.
